---
description: Adopt an existing project into Workspai governance
---

Adopt an existing project without changing its runtime behavior.

Read first:

- `.workspai/reports/INDEX.json`
- `.workspai/reports/workspace-context-agent.json`
- Any report referenced by the current blocker or task

Return:

1. Detected stack and confidence
2. Adoption plan
3. Generated metadata expectations
4. Doctor and workspace model verification

Use the standard Workspai answer contract: Scope, Evidence, Diagnosis, Fix Plan, Run, Verify, Assumptions.
